text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered alert: router-p99-latency-high (rule: router.latency.p99 > 1200ms for 2m) — paging eng-oncall :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident 924812 created and routed to schedule eng-oncall. Link: https://pd.example/INC924812
eng-oncall: ack — taking it (sre-emma)
eng-oncall: quick check: any customer facing reports?
sre-emma: checking dashboards now — short spike around 16:02-16:04, p99 ~1.4s, p95 ~300ms. No 5xx increase on frontend logs.
kevin-ops: saw a small burst of router owner CPU on router-az-east-2a at 16:03, maybe a transient GC or noisy tenant.
maria-platform: autoscaler triggered an extra router pod at 16:03, should've absorbed load.
eng-oncall: incident-bot shows auto-resolve at 16:05 — page cleared itself. Did PD auto-resolve?
pagerduty: INC924812 auto-resolved via alert policy (no ack within auto-resolve window).
sre-emma: hmmm, I acked it at 16:02 — looks like PD retried and created a duplicate incident when the original auto-resolved then retriggered. We're in an ack-retry loop.
ops-lead-jordan: that pattern can spam on-call. Can we suppress retriggers for the same signature for 5m?
eng-oncall: agree, but first confirm root cause. Maria, can you grab router pod logs around 16:00-16:05?
maria-platform: grabbing logs, grep for high-latency spans and OOM/GC markers. One pod shows long GC at 16:02:12 -> pause ~900ms, then recovered. No OOMs.
sre-emma: correlating traces — top upstream service had a short kube-proxy conn reset storm for ~30s. Likely transient network flakiness causing tail latency.
kevin-ops: added temporary routing fallback for the few router replicas in that AZ to shift traffic away while we investigate. Command I ran:
```
kubectl patch svc router-az-east-2a -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'
```
(reverted after autoscaler stabilized)
eng-oncall: good. PD retriggered at 16:07 for same rule -> created INC924813, auto-resolve at 16:09, then INC924814 at 16:11 — three quick pages.
eng-oncall: I'm going to manually escalate and mark as acknowledged to stop the retry loop. @pagerduty please set INC924813/14 to acknowledged by eng-oncall.
pagerduty: Acknowledged INC924813 and INC924814 as requested.
sre-emma: manual mitigation verified — p99 back under 300ms. No customer reports in support. Impact: none observed beyond internal latency alerting.
ops-lead-jordan: follow-up action: tweak alert to require sustained >1200ms for 3m or add suppression for retriggers within 10m for the same host group. Also consider lowering auto-resolve aggressiveness.
eng-oncall: filing a follow-up ticket and tagging oncall-playbook. Suggested runbook change snippet:
```
alert "router-p99-latency-high" {
  for = 3m
  group_suppression = { "window": "10m", "key": "router-az-${az}" }
}
```
kevin-ops: +1. Also suggest adding an incident-bot annotation that links the autoscaler events so we can correlate earlier.
maria-platform: will add a debug harvest for router GC traces for the next 24h to see if pattern repeats.
sre-emma: closing notes: transient network glitch + one long GC produced tail latency; autoscaler and fallback prevented customer impact; PD policy caused flapping pages. Recommend adjusting thresholds + PD suppression.
eng-oncall: thanks team — will update detection config and file a board-level postmortem-lite in #postmortems if we see another flare. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
